payload.instruction: Make her close her jacket fully
payload.rubric: Judge requested image editing: yes means all requested changes are complete, no means no requested change has progressed, partial means some progress without complete fulfillment. Unrelated edits are not requested progress. Insufficient evidence stays unresolved.

node.question: Comparing the same jacket in the source and edited images, what progress toward closing it is visibly evident?
node.criteria: complete: the jacket is fully closed, with its front edges meeting or overlapping along the opening and no substantial inner layer exposed. partial: the edited jacket is visibly more closed than in the source, such as front edges moving closer together or less inner layer exposed, but it remains partly open. absent: there is no visible progress toward closing the jacket compared with the source, or it is equally or more open. unknown: the jacket, its opening, or the source-to-edit comparison is too occluded, low-resolution, or otherwise unclear to determine progress or completion.
node.binding: Visual target: the woman's jacket. Compare its visible front opening and exposed inner layer in the source and edited images; do not infer closure from pose or jacket movement alone.

outcome.description: The woman’s jacket is closed fully.
outcome.reference: Make her close her jacket fully

response.content: {"status":"absent","evidence":"The jacket’s front opening is visible in the source, with a dark inner layer exposed. In the edited image the jacket is swung outward and its front opening remains exposed; there is no visible progress toward closing it.","confidence":0.91}
